name: Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP) with Variable Interval Weights
description: TWAP measures the average price of an asset weighted by the duration of time that each price level was sustained, preventing brief price spikes from distorting valuation.
prompt:
TWAP measures the average price of an asset weighted by the duration of time that each price level was sustained, preventing brief price spikes from distorting valuation.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: symbol, twap_price, total_duration_seconds.
Results should be ordered as specified.
setup_sql:
CREATE TABLE price_ticks (
                tick_time TIMESTAMP,
                symbol VARCHAR,
                price DOUBLE
            );
            INSERT INTO price_ticks VALUES
                ('2026-03-01 10:00:00', 'ETH', 3000.00), -- lasted 10 min
                ('2026-03-01 10:10:00', 'ETH', 3050.00), -- lasted 20 min
                ('2026-03-01 10:30:00', 'ETH', 3010.00), -- lasted 30 min
                ('2026-03-01 11:00:00', 'ETH', 3010.00); -- window end
golden_sql:
-- Calculate 1-hour TWAP from 10:00 to 11:00
            WITH tick_durations AS (
                SELECT 
                    symbol,
                    tick_time,
                    price,
                    date_diff('second', tick_time, 
                        LEAD(tick_time, 1, TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 11:00:00') OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tick_time)
                    ) AS duration_seconds
                FROM price_ticks
                WHERE tick_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 11:00:00'
            )
            SELECT 
                symbol,
                ROUND(SUM(price * duration_seconds) / SUM(duration_seconds), 2) AS twap_price,
                SUM(duration_seconds) AS total_duration_seconds
            FROM tick_durations
            GROUP BY symbol;
why_it_fails: Taking simple AVG(price) biases the result towards periods with frequent tick updates rather than sustained duration.
